UWF Board of Trustees regulations.
Notices pertaining to Regulation creation, amendment, and repeal are posted for a period of 30 days with a comment period for the first 14 days of the 30-day period. Anyone may comment on the proposed changes during the comment period by following the instructions contained in the notice.
